title: Trump leans in on targeting Russian oil revenue as he tries to fulfill pledge to end Ukraine war
description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump is emphasizing that targeting Russia's oil revenue is the best way to get Moscow to end its nearly three-year war against Ukraine.

title: Putin Calls for Summit with Trump to Address Ukraine War and Energy Prices
description: Russian President Vladimir Putin expressed a desire to meet with U.S. President Donald Trump to discuss the Ukraine war and energy prices. He emphasized that peace talks with Ukraine hinge on the West pressing President Zelenskiy to lift a decree preventing negotiations with Russia.

title: Russia brushes off Trump’s threats on Ukraine
description: Moscow believes it has the resources and manpower to withstand at least another year of the conflict.

title: Europe considers sending troops to Ukraine in cease-fire
description: Europe considers stationing thousands of troops in Ukraine in the case of a cease-fire with Moscow to serve as a deterrent should Russia invade again.

title: Russia’s Putin ready to meet Trump for talks on Ukraine and other issues
description: Kyiv says Ukraine and Europe must be at table for any talks that affect them

title: Russia claims its troops are in the last stages of taking another eastern Ukraine town
description: For the past year, Russian forces have attempted to punch holes in Ukraine’s defenses in the Donetsk region and weaken Kyiv’s grip on the eastern parts of the country.

title: Trump Urges OPEC to Slash Oil Prices
description: U.S. President Donald Trump has reiterated his demand for OPEC to lower oil prices, aiming to impact Russia's finances and hasten the end of the Ukraine conflict. Trump believes that causing a financial strain on Russia could bring the war to a swift conclusion.

title: Orbán's Gas Gamble: Hungary's EU Intervention Appeal
description: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has urged the European Union to intervene in Hungary's gas dispute with Ukraine. He blames EU sanctions on Russia for raising energy prices and costing Hungary billions. Orbán suggested he might veto the upcoming sanctions unless EU leaders help restore Ukrainian gas transit.

title: Putin 'Ready' to Talk to Trump, Kremlin Says
description: Russia is waiting for signals from Washington to commence highly anticipated peace negotiations to end the war with Ukraine.
